reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating an autonomous, artifact-driven product delivery pipeline from research and planning through implementation, review, testing, memory curation, and release audit.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的产品交付编排插件，可协调多角色智能体完成从研究、规划和实现到评审、测试及发布审计的端到端工作流。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness orchestration plugin that coordinates role-based agents across an artifact-driven product delivery workflow from research and planning through implementation, review, testing, and release audit.

capabilities: Orchestrates a multi-stage product delivery workflow
Coordinates multiple role-based and parallel agents
Generates product, architecture, implementation, review, testing, and release artifacts
Performs code implementation and deterministic testing according to stated contracts
Maintains evidence-based memory candidates and workflow improvement proposals
Runs read-only performance and release audits
